ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the outline in the figure is of a certain country at the southern end of Africa, marked with the 20°E meridian and the 30°S parallel, and Port Jia is located on the southwestern coast of this country; the legend shows that the northeastern and eastern areas are the main corn-producing areas, and there is also a timeline for corn sowing period and harvest period. Combining the stem statement that "manufacturing and mining are the economic pillars," this country can be judged to be South Africa, and Port Jia is on the southwestern coast of South Africa. Then reason: in July, the ship sets out from Port Jia and transports to Shanghai via the west coast of Australia. From South Africa to the west coast of Australia it mainly sails eastward, and can make use of the West Wind Drift in the middle and high latitudes of the Southern Hemisphere flowing eastward; when going north along the west coast of Australia, the West Australian Cold Current generally flows northward, also consistent with the sailing direction; continuing northward to Shanghai, the main voyage sections do not constitute being mainly against the current. Therefore, most of the route is with the current.
